verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents database connectors with incremental syncs and a 'Capture deletes' feature (e.g., fivetran-docs-13, -51, -66) plus sync modes (Soft Delete, History Mode) supporting update/delete tracking, which implies CDC-style capture. However, the evidence pack never explicitly names log-based CDC or binlog/WAL mechanisms, nor discusses source-load impact, so the specific replication method claimed in the story isn't directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit binlog/WAL CDC documentation, evidence of reduced source query load, and independent/community confirmation of CDC mechanics.
